title: Certifying Retraining Regret through Residual Structure
abstract: arXiv:2610.41410v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We certify a fixed ridge predictor's regret against full-feature retraining over every continuous completion of an interval-valued table. Our main theorem gives verifiable original-row residual conditions for a uniform error bound independent of nuisance-feature scale and rank, with an asymptotically sharp leading constant and quantitative leakage stability. Full-rank constructions separate certification dimension from feature dimension, including examples requiring directions beyond the candidate. Observed-row anchors make the conditions computable, while exact row geometry and global search return valid upper bounds and feasible original-table witnesses. A finite-scale contraction and common-domain moment fallback implement the structural result. Four real-world tasks retain all model features and certify twenty rank-three instances to width $10^{-5}$. Their primary median widths improve over centered moments. Joint residual refinement

translated_title: 通过残差结构认证重训练遗憾值
translated_abstract: 我们针对区间值表格的每一个连续补全，认证了一个固定岭回归预测器相对于全特征重训练的遗憾值。我们的主要定理给出了可验证的原始行残差条件，用以保证一个与干扰特征尺度和秩无关的一致误差界，该误差界具有渐近锐利的首项常数以及定量的泄漏稳定性。满秩构造将认证维度与特征维度分离开来，其中包括需要超出候选方向之外的额外方向的实例。观测行锚点使得这些条件变得可计算，而精确的行几何分析与全局搜索则返回有效的上界以及可行的原始表格见证。有限尺度收缩和共同域矩回退机制实现了这一结构性结果。在四个真实世界任务中，该方法保留了所有模型特征，并认证了二十个秩为三的实例，认证宽度达到 $10^{-5}$。其主要的 中位数认证宽度优于中心化矩方法。联合残差细化……
tldr: 该论文提出一种基于残差结构的认证框架，可为固定岭回归预测器在区间值数据所有可能补全下相对于全特征重训练的遗憾值提供可验证的一致误差界，且该误差界与干扰特征尺度和秩无关，在真实任务上实现了宽度达 $10^{-5}$ 的高精度认证。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a residual-structure-based certification framework that provides verifiable uniform bounds on a fixed ridge predictor's regret against full-feature retraining over all continuous completions of interval-valued tables, with bounds independent of nuisance-feature scale and rank, achieving certification widths as tight as $10^{-5}$ on real-world tasks.
